events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: The Day The Music Video Arrived
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, changing music forever. The first track? The ironically titled 'Video Killed The Radio Star' by The Buggles. Did it, though?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe,' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop's Big Bang
angles.copy: It's 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe'. A landmark album that kicked off a whole new era for British music. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love, and Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, hundreds of thousands gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. A festival that truly defined a generation.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll,' passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: The King's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today, the world lost a legend. Elvis Presley's music continues to define rock and roll. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential rapper Tupac Shakur passed away on September 13, 1996, in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Impact
angles.copy: Thirty years today, the music world lost Tupac Shakur. His powerful lyrics and enduring legacy continue to resonate across generations.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost the incomparable Jimi Hendrix. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road,' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Turns 57
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks – a true masterpiece. What's the first song you think of?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders frontwoman still rocks harder than most. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll attitude. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: The Power of Imagine
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago today, John Lennon released his timeless album 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod. It put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No,' in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' first hit screens. What's your favourite Bond theme song or iconic 007 moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message of peace continue to inspire the world.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Turns 58
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles released their groundbreaking 'White Album'. An experimental masterpiece that pushed boundaries. What are your standout tracks?
